description: This file implements the LayoutManager class and related functions for managing tensor memory layouts within the torch::nativert namespace, including allocation, deallocation, and storage management.

classes.name: LayoutManager
classes.description: Manages tensor memory layout planning, allocation, and deallocation within an execution frame.

classes.name: ContiguousLayoutBuffer
classes.description: Handles buffer allocation and deallocation for contiguous tensor memory layouts.

methods.name: LayoutManager::LayoutManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing LayoutManager with planner, parent frame, and settings.

methods.name: ContiguousLayoutBuffer::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory buffer of specified size.

methods.name: LayoutManager::allocate
methods.description: Performs memory allocation based on current state and plan.

methods.name: LayoutManager::allocate_plan
methods.description: Allocates memory according to a given layout plan.

methods.name: LayoutManager::ensure_managed_storages
methods.description: Ensures storage buffers are allocated and managed for tensors.

methods.name: LayoutManager::populate_tensor_values
methods.description: Populates tensors with values from the parent frame based on the plan.

methods.name: LayoutManager::assert_no_overlapping_storages
methods.description: Debug function to verify no overlapping storage slices (only in debug builds).

methods.name: LayoutManager::try_update_historical_max_nbytes
methods.description: Updates maximum byte size statistics for tensors.

methods.name: LayoutManager::deallocate_and_plan
methods.description: Deallocates current buffers and prepares for a new planning cycle.
